jobs.title: Key Account Manager
jobs.description:
Location and work model: La-Tour-de-Peilz, with regular customer visits across Switzerland and a remote working policy
Contract type / duration: Permanent
Activity rate: 80–100%

Be a force for good and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet

As a Key Account Manager at Nestlé Purina PetCare Switzerland, your mission is to own and steer the commercial performance of strategic retail customers in Switzerland, delivering sustainable growth, profitability, market share and excellent execution. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with customer stakeholders and with Sales, Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain and key support teams. This is your opportunity to take ownership, grow your expertise, and deliver meaningful results that make a difference at scale.

How you’ll make an impact as a Key Account Manager

• Leading the commercial performance of assigned retail customers, taking ownership of sales, profitability, market share, distribution, forecasting and trade investment outcomes

• Driving customer strategy and joint business planning that translate category priorities into strong customer plans and sustainable profitable growth

• Building trusted relationships with key customer stakeholders and leading impactful negotiations supported by strong financial insight, clear priorities and sound investment choices

• Steering accurate customer forecasting, baseline and promotional planning, while driving best-in-class execution of promotions, launches, distribution initiatives and commercial plans to strengthen customer and category performance

• Turning shopper, category, customer and financial insights into fact-based recommendations that improve business performance and decision-making

• Aligning cross-functional teams around customer priorities, enabling focused execution and creating shared value for customers, consumers and Purina

What will make you successful

• Bringing relevant expertise gained through education or professional experience combined with proven track record in solid key account management in fast-moving consumer goods or retail, with proven ownership of customer growth, profitability and market share

• Bringing eCommerce experience would be a strong asset

• Applying strong commercial and financial acumen to manage customer performance, trade investments, forecasting, budgeting and profitability decisions

• Using negotiation, customer planning and relationship-building skills to influence senior stakeholders and deliver mutually valuable business outcome

• Collaborating across functions with confidence, resilience and accountability to turn strategies, insights and priorities into excellent execution

• Communicating fluently in German and English, French is an advantage.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning, while translating ideas into measurable impact and creating shared value

At Nestlé Purina PetCare Switzerland, we place people at the heart of everything we do

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Performance based bonus

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Strong employer contribution to your pension plan

• Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support solutions

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

jobs.title: Head of GBS Finance
jobs.description:
Location: Vevey, Switzerland
Act. Rate: Full-Time, 100%
Contract type / duration: Permanent contract

Start date: February 2027

Deadline for applications: 25 September 2026

Be a force for good and grow through experiences that push you further

As the Head of Global Business Services Finance at Nestlé, your mission is to act as a key finance partner to the Head of GBS and the GBS Management Team. You will shape the financial roadmap, challenge business decisions, and ensure disciplined planning, performance management, cost transparency and value realization across the global GBS network. Working closely with Center Heads, End-to-End solution leads, Global Process Owners, Markets, IT & Digital, and external partners, you will provide forward-looking insights, enable fact-based decisions, and strengthen accountability for financial outcomes. You will lead an international finance team in different locations and help GBS deliver sustainable efficiency, effectiveness, and business value.

How you’ll make an impact as a Head of GBS Finance

• Bring deep expertise in the operational financial management of Global Business Services, using cost, efficiency, quality and service-performance insights to improve both efficiency and effectiveness.

• While leveraging AI tools, develop and maintain unit-cost, productivity and service-performance measures that connect financial outcomes with operational volumes, quality and service levels. Use internal and external benchmarks to identify improvement opportunities.

• Planning, coordinating and maintaining cost control of our Business Centers operations, measuring performance against plan and proposing necessary action plans to achieve targets in a context of important transition plan.

• Ensure challenging stretched targets are set for each Shared Service Center, end-to-end solution lead and Management Services unit, and tracking performance in a timely manner.

• Establish and govern a consistent framework to validate, track and report productivity, transformation benefits and value delivery, including agreed baselines, ownership, timing and reconciliation to reported financial results.

• Ensure a robust, documented and transparent billing and reconciliation process across the GBS network, including accurate and timely charges to internal customers, clear allocation drivers, dispute resolution and compliance with applicable transfer-pricing and accounting requirements.

• Own and continuously improve a transparent, driver-based costing and charging model for GBS services. Define financial evaluation and performance-tracking methodologies, assess business cases and contract changes, and ensure continuity plans reflect current financial exposures and operational requirements.

• Lead financial and commercial governance of external service providers, including contract economics, rate cards, indexation, volume commitments, service credits, change requests, invoice validation and value-for-money assessments.

• Lead, develop and inspire your team in an international environment while working collaboratively and cross functionally with IT & Digital, Global Process Owners and Markets.

What will make you successful

• Demonstrating senior finance leadership experience in GBS operational financial models and in complex global organizations, supported by relevant finance, accounting or business qualification.

• Applying financial analysis and co-piloting experience to various senior stakeholders through a strong command of management accounting, planning and forecasting, service costing, investment appraisal, financial controls and commercial contract management.

• Developing and improving financial systems and major business processes, with exposure to audit, project financial evaluation and contract reviews.

• Strong focus on compliance, rock solid reporting and internal controls.

• Managing and developing people, including virtual teams, with good organizational and planning skills.

• Communicating fluently in English, with superior written and verbal communication skills to effectively address and influence all levels, leadership team and internal customers.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning, while translating ideas into measurable impact and creating shared value.

At Nestlé, we care about our people

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities

• Performance based bonus

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Strong employer contribution to your pension plan

• Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support solutions

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to a fair and transparent hiring process and ensure all applications are treated confidentially.

Your application will typically include an initial review, conversations with Talent Acquisition, and the hiring team, followed by a final discussion.

Ready to grow with us?

Apply now and grow through experiences that push you further.

Shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.

As a Senior Technician in Micronutrients and Phytochemicals Analytics at Nestlé Research, your mission is to provide high-quality analytical support that helps research and operations teams make confident, science-based decisions. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with scientists, analytical experts, technical teams and partners across Nestlé Research. This is your opportunity to turn ideas into sustainable and innovative solutions for people, pets, and the planet.

How you’ll make an impact as a Senior Technician in Micronutrients and Phytochemicals Analytics

• Delivering reliable analytical data that supports research, product quality and operational decisions.

• Developing and applying sample preparation methods within projects, including approaches for allergens, microparticles, micronutrients and phytochemicals analysis as well as spectroscopic measurements.

• Operating and maintaining advanced analytical equipment to ensure robust, timely and high-quality results.

• Evaluating analytical outcomes critically and turning results into clear insights for project teams and stakeholders.

• Contributing to method development and providing technical assistance to markets, including analytical support for allergen-related topics where the role may require handling or being in direct contact with allergenic food materials.

• Supporting project teams with technical assistance, sample preparation for trace analysis and analytical interpretation to ensure robust delivery of project objectives.

• Sharing expertise with colleagues, apprentices and students to build capability across analytical activities.

What will make you successful

• Bringing a Bachelor’s degree, CFC or equivalent qualification in analytical chemistry or a related field, with solid experience in sample preparation gained in industry or academia.

• Applying hands-on knowledge of allergen analysis and being comfortable working in a laboratory environment where allergenic food materials may be handled, prepared or analyzed, with potential direct contact as part of the role. Shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.

As a Digital Food Safety Early Warning Associate Specialist at Nestlé Research, your mission is to enable the proactive detection of potential food safety issues by strengthening the evaluation of external scientific signals and the evolution of digital early warning systems.. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with food safety, quality, research, technology, and external data partners. This is your opportunity to turn ideas into sustainable and innovative solutions for people, pets, and the planet.

How you’ll make an impact as a Digital Food Safety Early Warning Associate Specialist

• Strengthening proactive food safety early warning by scouting and evaluating emerging issues across priority contaminant areas.

• Identifying and assessing internal and external data sources that improve the detection, prioritization, and scientific evaluation of early signals.

• Contribute to the evaluation and deployment of digital technologies that enhance data-driven detection of emerging food safety topics.

• Testing prototypes that help transform early warning processes into scalable digital solutions.

• Participate in scientific collaborations that connect research, technology, and business needs to protect consumers.

• Delivering project activities with focus, rigor, and follow-through to support impactful food safety decisions.

What will make you successful

• Bringing basic chemistry knowledge and a good understanding of chemical contaminants, including how they can emerge, evolve, and impact food safety.

• Applying knowledge of food safety and quality processes in the context of supply chains, incident occurrence, issue evolution, and potential consumer impact.

• Using data and digital technologies in a food safety context, ideally to support data-driven risk assessment, root-cause analysis, and early warning decision-making.

• Collaborating effectively with diverse internal and external partners, while translating research into practical business impact.

• Communicating fluently in English; working proficiency in French is a plus.

• Bringing collaboration, fresh thinking, bold questions, respect, and a positive, wellbeing-oriented mindset.

jobs.description:
Lieu : stages disponibles sur nos 3 centres de production (Romont / Avenches / Orbe)
Taux : temps plein 100%
Type de contrat : contrat de stage à durée déterminée (6 mois)
Démarrage souhaité 1er trimestre 2027

Reimagine what coffee can be. Reimagine what you can become.

En tant que Stagiaire Ingénieur-e Production et/ou Logistique + Amélioration Continue , vous étudiez, proposez et prenez en charge la mise en place d’une structure d’amélioration continue inspirée de TPM (Total Performance Management) sur des lignes de production ou en zone logistique.

Comment aurez-vous un impact en tant que Stagiaire Ingénieur-e Production et/ou Logistique + Amélioration Continue ?

• Analyser les tendances des indicateurs de performance de sa zone (fiabilité, arrêts planifiés, arrêts mineurs, pertes, blocages, …) afin d’initier des démarches de résolution de problèmes ou des projets d’améliorations et prendre les actions nécessaires pour atteindre les objectifs
• Assurer l’interface entre la production et ou logistique et les différents départements et garantir le suivi, la mise en place et la communication des actions d’améliorations de sa zone
• Coordonner les activités d’amélioration continue, de TPM et de digitalisation entre les équipes et coacher dans l’analyse et la résolution des problèmes récurrents
• Assurer la mise à jour des procédures et standard et garantir leur application

Ce qui fera votre réussite

• Etudiant-e en école d’Ingénieur-e
• Connaissance des outils d’amélioration continue et/ou TPM
• Expérience dans l’industrie agro-alimentaire (un atout)
• Capacité d’analyse et de résolution de problèmes
• Capacités à travailler en équipe pluridisciplinaire
• Aisance en communication.

Avantages

• 5 semaines de vacances
• Possibilité de formation et de développement internes
• Caisse de pension avec excellentes contributions de l’employeur
• Participation financière à l’assurance maladie
• Politique parentalité avantageuse
• Restaurant d’entreprise sur place avec menus à prix subventionnés
• Parking gratuit et bornes de recharge pour voitures électriques
• Nombreux avantages auprès du Club Nespresso

jobs.title: Ingénieur·e Réfrigération
jobs.description:
Lieu : Orbe, Suisse
Modèle de travail : Sur site / Temps plein
Type de contrat / durée : CDI

Date d’entrée : à déterminer

Résumé du poste

En tant qu’Ingénieur·e réfrigération, ta mission est d’apporter ton expertise technique pour garantir le fonctionnement sûr, fiable et efficace de nos installations de froid industriel. Tu feras la différence en collaborant étroitement avec la maintenance, la production, les services industriels, les équipes projets et les partenaires techniques afin de renforcer la sécurité, la conformité et l’excellence opérationnelle. Ce rôle clé te permettra de connecter avec des spécialistes, de développer ton expertise et de créer un impact pour la fabrique et à l’échelle du site.

Ton impact en tant qu’Ingénieur·e réfrigération

• Supportant les projets d’investissement CAPEX liés à la réfrigération, à travers la gestion de l’ingénierie de projet, de la définition technique jusqu’à la mise en service et au démarrage opérationnel.

• Garantissant la conformité des installations de froid industriel avec les exigences légales, les standards internes et les règles de sécurité applicables.

• Soutenant les équipes de maintenance dans le diagnostic, la fiabilisation et l’amélioration continue des équipements de réfrigération industrielle.

• Développant les compétences des équipes terrain grâce à des supports de formation clairs et un coaching orienté sécurité, performance et efficacité.

• Identifiant des opportunités d’amélioration pour renforcer la fiabilité des installations, réduire les pertes et optimiser les coûts d’exploitation.

• Renforçant une culture de prévention, de collaboration et d’excellence opérationnelle pour viser zéro accident, zéro impact environnemental et zéro perte.

Ce qui fera ta réussite dans le rôle

• Titulaire d’un diplôme en ingénierie mécanique, chimique, industrielle ou dans une discipline équivalente.

• Apportant une solide expertise dans le domaine des services industriels, du froid industriel (min, 1 an), et maintenance d’équipements techniques.

• Appliquant une approche structurée de résolution de problèmes pour analyser les causes racines et améliorer durablement la fiabilité des installations.

• Utilisant tes compétences en gestion de projets techniques pour coordonner des investissements, des mises en service et des démarrages d’équipements.

• Collaborant efficacement avec des équipes multidisciplinaires, des fournisseurs et des experts techniques pour obtenir des résultats concrets.

• Communiquant couramment en français et en anglais.

• Faire preuve de courage, de collaboration, de réactivité et d’apprentissage continu.

Chez NCH, nous plaçons les personnes au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons.

Nous offrons un ensemble d’avantages compétitif et complet, conçu pour soutenir ta croissance et ton bien-être au travail comme dans ta vie personnelle :

• 5 semaines de vacances

• Participation aux frais de santé et programme d’aide aux employés pour toi et ta famille

• Forte contribution de l’employeur à ton plan de prévoyance

• Congé parental généreux et solutions complètes de soutien à la famille

• Opportunités d’apprentissage et de développement pour faire grandir tes compétences

• Remises attractives pour les employés sur des produits et services du quotidien

Ce à quoi t’attendre dans notre processus de recrutement

Nous nous engageons à offrir une expérience de recrutement inclusive et respectueuse, et nous sommes disponibles pour mettre en place des aménagements raisonnables si nécessaire. Nos lieux de travail sont entièrement accessibles et soutenus par une forte culture sécurité, avec des installations modernes et des procédures visant à garantir un environnement sûr pour toutes et tous.

Le processus de recrutement comprend généralement un premier échange avec la recruteuse, un entretien avec la Responsable services industriels avec études de cas puis une discussion finale avec le Responsable ingénierie et une offre. Nous examinons les candidatures au fur et à mesure et nous clôturons le poste dès qu’une liste solide de candidat·e·s pertinent·e·s est identifiée ; nous t’encourageons donc à postuler dès que possible. Toutes les informations sont traitées de manière confidentielle.

Prêt·e à contribuer à la performance de notre fabrique ? Postule maintenant.

jobs.description:
Location: Lausanne, Switzerland
Work model: Office-based / Full time
Contract type / duration: Fixed-term contract (2 years)

Shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.

As a Bioprocess Engineer - Pilot Plant (Fermentation & DSP) at Nestlé Research, your mission is to lead bioprocessing activities that bridge lab-scale discovery and industrial manufacturing through robust fermentation and downstream processing solutions. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with pilot plant teams, scientists, engineers, quality and safety specialists, technical experts and external partners. This is your opportunity to turn ideas into sustainable and innovative solutions for people, pets, and the planet.

How you’ll make an impact as a Bioprocess Engineer - Pilot Plant (DSP)

• Leading pilot-scale bioprocess trials that help transform promising research into scalable manufacturing solutions.

• Driving fermentation process development by optimizing media, feeding strategies and key operating parameters for reliable performance.

• Developing downstream processing approaches that improve yield, recovery and product quality.

• Building process understanding through data analysis, automation insights and digital tools that support optimization and reproducibility.

• Contributing to safe, compliant and high-quality pilot plant operations through risk assessment, documentation and continuous improvement.

• Shaping the development of new biotech pilot plant capabilities by translating process needs into practical equipment and facility solutions.

What will make you successful

• Bringing strong expertise in fermentation, bioprocessing and pilot or industrial-scale operations.

• Applying scale-up, technology transfer and industrialization knowledge to make processes robust and ready for implementation.

• Using analytical thinking, process data and automation tools to troubleshoot, optimize and improve reproducibility.

• Collaborating across research, engineering, operations, quality and safety teams with ownership and a hands-on mindset.

• Communicating confidently and delivering presentations in French or English.

• Bringing collaboration, fresh thinking, bold questions, respect, and a positive, wellbeing-oriented mindset.

At Nestlé Research, we place people at the core of everything we do.

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office based roles)

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Performance based bonus

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Strong employer contribution to your pension plan

• Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support solutions

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes a video interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Ready to #BreakthroughTogether?

Apply now and shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.

#nestlecareerswitzerland

jobs.description:
Standort: Basel, Schweiz
Arbeitsmodell: Vollzeit, vor Ort, in geringem Umfang kann Home Office möglich sein

Vertragsart / Dauer: Unbefriestet

Startdatum: Per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung

Be a force for good and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet

Als Projektingenieur Bau & Projektkoordination bei der Nestlé Suisse besteht Ihre Mission darin, die Planung, Koordination und Realisierung von Bauprojekten unterschiedlicher Komplexität für unsere THOMY Fabrik in Basel sicherzustellen. Das Aufgabenspektrum reicht von kleineren Unterhalts- und Sanierungsmassnahmen bis hin zu Neu- und Umbauprojekten. Sie werden einen Unterschied machen, indem Sie eng mit internen Kunden, Behörden, Planern, Architekten, Ingenieuren und Unternehmern zusammenarbeiten. Dies ist Ihre Chance, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, Ihre Expertise weiterzuentwickeln und die Zukunft unseres Produktionsstandorts aktiv mitzugestalten.

So werden Sie als Projektingenieur Bau & Projektkoordination einen Unterschied machen

• Selbstständige Leitung und Begleitung von Bauprojekten von der Bedürfnisdefinition bis zur Inbetriebnahme.

• Planung, Ausschreibung, Vergabe und Überwachung von Bau- und Unterhaltsmassnahmen sowie Erstellung von Projekt-, Kosten- und Terminplänen und Sicherstellung deren Einhaltung.

• Führung und Koordination von externen Planern, Architekten, Ingenieuren und Unternehmern.

• Durchführung von Zustandsanalysen und Erarbeitung von Sanierungs- und Instandhaltungskonzepten sowie Organisation und Begleitung von Umbauten, Renovationen und kleineren Neubauprojekten.

• Überwachung der Bauausführung, Durchführung von Baustellenbegehungen sowie Kontrolle von Offerten, Rechnungen und Nachträgen.

• Sicherstellung der Einhaltung gesetzlicher sowie Nestlé-interner Vorschriften zur Arbeitssicherheit, interner Vorgaben, Qualitätsstandards und Compliance-Richtlinien für den Bereich Bau sowie Ansprechperson für interne Kunden, Behörden, Planer und Unternehmer.

Das macht Sie erfolgreich

• Hintergrund als Bauingenieur, Architekt, Techniker Bauplanung/Bauführung oder vergleichbare Qualifikation mit Erfahrung in der Projektleitung und Bauausführung.

• Erfahrung in der Planung, Koordination und Realisierung von Bau- und Umbauprojekten.

• Kenntnisse in Bauleitung, Ausschreibungen und Vergabeverfahren sowie ein gutes Verständnis für bautechnische, wirtschaftliche und organisatorische Zusammenhänge.

• Erfahrung im Umgang mit Behörden, Planern und Unternehmern sowie eine selbstständige, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise in enger Abstimmung mit den anderen Abteilungen der Fabrik.

• Ausgeprägte Kommunikations-, Organisations- und Durchsetzungsfähigkeiten sowie sicherer Umgang mit MS Office; Kenntnisse von CAD- oder Projektmanagement-Tools sind von Vorteil.

• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift; Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.

• Mut, Teamorientierung, Agilität und kontinuierliche Lernbereitschaft.

Bei Nestlé stehen Menschen im Mittelpunkt unseres Handelns

Unsere Benefits sind darauf ausgerichtet, Ihr Wachstum und Ihr Wohlbefinden zu fördern, damit Sie sowohl beruflich als auch privat erfolgreich sein können:

• Zusätzliche Ferientage über die gesetzlichen Anforderungen hinaus

• Beitrag an Gesundheitsleistungen sowie Zugang zum Employee Assistance Program für Sie und Ihre Familie

• Attraktive Arbeitgeberbeiträge an die Pensionskasse

• Leistungsorientierter Bonus

• Grosszügige Elternzeit und umfassende Familienunterstützung

• Vielfältige Lern- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten zur Weiterentwicklung Ihrer Fähigkeiten

• Mitarbeiterrabatte auf verschiedene Produkte und Dienstleistungen

Was Sie von unserem Rekrutierungsprozess erwarten können

Wir setzen uns für einen inklusiven und respektvollen Rekrutierungsprozess ein und stellen bei Bedarf gerne angemessene Unterstützungsmassnahmen zur Verfügung. Unsere Arbeitsplätze sind vollständig zugänglich und werden durch eine starke Sicherheitskultur unterstützt. Moderne Einrichtungen und Prozesse sorgen für ein sicheres Arbeitsumfeld für alle.

Der Rekrutierungsprozess umfasst in der Regel ein Gespräch mit Talent Acquisition, ein Interview mit dem Hiring Team sowie ein abschliessendes Gespräch und Angebot. Wir prüfen Bewerbungen laufend und schliessen die Ausschreibung, sobald wir eine starke Auswahl relevanter Kandidatinnen und Kandidaten identifiziert haben. Daher empfehlen wir eine frühzeitige Bewerbung. Alle Informationen werden vertraulich behandelt.

Vorsicht vor Betrugsversuchen: Nestlé kontaktiert Kandidatinnen und Kandidaten ausschliesslich über offizielle E-Mail-Adressen des Unternehmens und wird zu keinem Zeitpunkt im Rekrutierungsprozess Zahlungen oder sensible persönliche Informationen verlangen.

Bereit, eine Kraft für das Gute zu sein?

Bewerben Sie sich jetzt und beschleunigen Sie Veränderungen, die das Leben von Menschen und unseren Planeten verbessern.
